description: This file defines the Zend_Http_CookieJar class, which manages HTTP cookies within the Zend Framework. It includes methods for adding, retrieving, and filtering cookies, as well as handling cookies from HTTP responses.

classes.name: Zend_Http_CookieJar
classes.description: A class for managing HTTP cookies, supporting adding cookies, parsing responses, filtering by domain and path, and exporting cookies in various formats.

methods.name: addCookie
methods.description: Adds a cookie to the jar, accepting either a Zend_Http_Cookie object or a string.

methods.name: addCookiesFromResponse
methods.description: Parses an HTTP response to extract and add cookies to the jar.

methods.name: getAllCookies
methods.description: Returns all cookies in the jar, formatted as objects or strings.

methods.name: getMatchingCookies
methods.description: Retrieves cookies matching a specific URI, considering domain, path, and session cookies.

methods.name: getCookie
methods.description: Retrieves a specific cookie by URI and name, with options for return format.

methods.name: _flattenCookiesArray
methods.description: Helper to recursively flatten the cookies array into a list or string.

methods.name: _matchDomain
methods.description: Filters cookies matching a specific domain.

methods.name: _matchPath
methods.description: Filters cookies matching a specific path within matched domains.

methods.name: fromResponse
methods.description: Creates a CookieJar from an HTTP response, optionally associating it with a URI.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of cookies stored.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over the raw cookies.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the cookie jar is empty.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Clears all cookies from the jar.

search-terms: filter cookies by domain and path
